records.finding: Current definition reverses the direct supplier internal shift convention: M{n1,n2}_{k,l}=M_{k+n1,l+n2}, whereas supplier defines M{r}_d=M_{d-r}. With the written plus convention downstream arc multiplication a into S{-1,1} has bidegree (3,-1), contradicting (1,1). Correct local shift formula to minus convention before acceptance.

Closed graph definition incorrectly asserts a finite-rank free Q[a] representative after contractible summands are removed. The closed one-mark circle has cohomology Q[x]{-1,1}, killed by a and infinite dimensional over Q; no finite-rank Q[a] complex can have this cohomology because Q[a] is Noetherian. Remove incorrect finite-rank assertion while preserving intended factorization construction.

Current proof of variable exclusion assumes arbitrary polynomial entries are linear in y: step 1.2 writes a_i=a_i prime+y a_i double prime with all coefficients in R prime, which is false for y squared. Clause (3) also drops quadratic rows and claims remaining linear entries alone compute closed graph homology. A closed wide-edge resolution retains the quadratic Koszul relation. Graded row operations further require homogeneous degree compatibility. Need complete repaired proof and claim reconciliation.

Current definition incorrectly states the rank-two left/right free bimodule B_i is generated as a left and right module by 1 tensor 1 alone. Its last Size paragraph further asserts F_i tensor - and - tensor F_i agree by canonical symmetry for commutative R; balanced bimodule tensor is not generally symmetric. Keep the true generator complexes but repair these assertions before acceptance.

Current cancellation proof step 1.2 falsely identifies alpha_i tensor 1+1 tensor alpha_i with 2(1 tensor alpha_i) inside B_i=R tensor over R^s R. The two alpha_i actions differ; specialization to the graph of s sends their sum to zero but sends 2(1 tensor alpha_i) to nonzero. The true inversion theorem needs an actual correct pivot computation rather than this false identity.

Current definition equates isotopy of curves with membership in one orbit of the full boundary-fixed mapping class group G. Full mapping classes send arcs to nonisotopic arcs (e.g. a Dehn twist of an intersecting arc); isotopy of images is instead the orbit of the identity component. Repair the isotopy sentence and reconcile the stated basic-arc/endpoints conventions before current acceptance.

Current reduced invariant-ring formula R^s_i=Q[y_j(j not i),y_i squared] is false for m>=3 since its own action sends neighboring y_j to y_j+y_i. Correct invariant coordinates are y_j+y_i/2 for neighbors. The same definition calls R[t_i] free rank two over R on {1,t_i}, although the polynomial extension is free infinite rank. These false claims require repair before downstream HHH audits.

Current definition incorrectly uses neighboring y_j as s_i-invariants in proving rb_i bimodule linearity, says t_i lies in R^s_i even though t_i is not in reduced R, and claims arbitrary coordinate x_1 or t_i gives a trivial bimodule polynomial factor for products of different simple reflections. A coordinate must be invariant under all reflections in the product, e.g. sum of x_j. Current source-convention explanation falsely waives that condition.

new_native_findings_history.reason: Definition claims the normalized Euler series belongs to the Laurent ring T0=Z[q^±1,t^±1,alpha^±1/2], but its own unknot value t^-1 q/(1-q^2) does not belong to that ring. Add the (1-q^2) localization or explicitly use the q-adic formal series completion; preserve the same normalization formula and unknot value. Carry inherited AC for use of link-invariance supplier where needed.

The negative-letter normalization display/proof inserts the balanced-root sign epsilon_i into the library positive multiplication differential. In the direct library supplier epsilon_i is the name of the multiplication MAP, not a scalar sign multiplier. Its positive differential is ordinary multiplication; only eta_i contains the balanced-root sign. Preserve all letter isomorphisms, correcting the typed differential and making the negative comparison exact rather than falsely a root-sign multiple.

Current Example promises all surviving terms/differentials and explicit chain maps/contractions, but proof gives only assertions of unit pivots/identical survivors and no displayed four-term survivor. The repaired direct triple-relation supplier now provides the actual two identity pivots, full survivor matrix, sign isomorphism and composed chain maps. Include and cite those current computations explicitly to fulfill the unchanged approved example claim.

FactF3 and proof1.1 claim all internal variables can be removed leaving polynomial ring in external variables; closed unknot has no external variables but retains Q[x], so only eliminable internal variables may be removed. Part1 Markov/link invariance and HOMFLYPT uniqueness still rely on a published Theorem1 assertion and unspecified descending-diagram uniqueness rather than complete current local proof/supplier uses. Spell out the published-v2 crossing regrading, both stabilization corrections, unlink values and finite skein induction; respect the AC qualification of the actual Markov supplier for oriented-link descent rather than silently declaring the entire argument choice-free.

The signed word Definition says degrees 0,...,r with binomial(r,m) terms although its negative letter lies in degrees -1,0. For r_- negative letters and r_+ positives the actual range is -r_-,...,r_+, with binomial(r,m+r_-) summands. Correct this unchanged construction and declare the two explicitly cited finite-free/derived-tensor suppliers.

The final Definition sentence says the chosen unit u is not determined by the remaining data, whereas its own unit triangle at f=g=1 forces u=mu_(1,1) since F_1=Id. Remove the false independence assertion; arbitrary nonidentity units remain possible jointly with their compositors.

Proof3.1 calls identity maps the only degree-zero endomorphism classes, contradicting FactF1 Hom=Q: all scalar multiples exist. Identity is the unique class with normalized derived identity image. Repair this proof clause; the transitivity and inverse claims are sound.

FactF3/proof1.1 incorrectly attribute distant crossing commutation to ReidemeisterIIa. Far commutation instead uses the signed tensor flip of independent local crossing factors over their disjoint variable blocks, with extra straight variables carried identically. Proof2.1 puts three cohomological/internal shifts in curly braces and claims chain isomorphism after composing equivalences; correct notation to {k0,l0}[n0] and retain homotopy equivalence. Approved full AC-conditional link-invariance claim remains intact.

Proof1.2/Remarks identify c_tu literally with identity and c_uw=c_tw despite different tensor-word domains. They become identity only after transporting all graph words by their multiplication maps mu_a to common R_(sts)(-3). Display the typed c_ab=mu_b^-1 mu_a and their cancellation; preserve full worked loop/transitivity claim.

The Example lists only three tensors as generators of B1 tensor B2 although its own proof1.1 correctly gives a four-element left basis. Its d0 display does not specify the pair in the declared summand order. Mirror the four actual basis tensors/degrees and typed d0=(x epsilon2(y),epsilon1(x)y); main complex and verification remain sound.

Proof1.1 tensors a merely left-linear splitting of M on its right over A_m, which is not defined; analogously the stated right-side split of N is on the wrong tensor side. For left projectivity split N as left A_m-module and apply M tensor_A -, obtaining direct summand of shifts of M with left action on M; for right projectivity split M as right module and apply - tensor_A N. This proves unchanged two-sided projectivity claim.

Statement claims any two word complexes are canonically isomorphic, but proof2.1 supplies only an isomorphism chosen along a finite relation sequence and explicitly disclaims coherence. The source Proposition2.7 asserts weak action only; canonical path independence is not supplied. Retain full weak action and explicit relation-sequence equivalences, replacing unsupported canonical uniqueness with chosen explicit homotopy equivalences. Also proof1.1 must compare arbitrary chosen inverse representative with literal reversed inverse word via2.1.

Proof1.1 falsely says x5 occurs only in the bottom linear row, while displayed quadratic x1*x5-x3*x4 still contains x5. Exclusion does allow substitution in all remaining rows; remove incorrect occurrence claim. Proof2.1 gives the same quadratic second row in both crossing terms, yet psi morphism targets the linear row (0,x5-x3). Spell out these two different source/target rows, substitution naturality for both psi/psi-prime crossing maps, and explain canonical invariant as the well-defined graded isomorphism class unless a canonical map is proved. Preserve full no-shift marking invariance.
